notes.title: Games Tycoon is available for wishlist
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that my new game Games Tycoon is available for wishlist on Steam.
Games Tycoon is a video game development simulator in which you can set up your own game studio and work your way to the top of the video games industry

The game will have many unique and interesting features, as well as retain the main advantages of PC Tycoon 2 and Mobiles Tycoon – dynamic gameplay, user-friendly and beautiful interface and wide technical functionality

I'm going to support Games Tycoon much longer that PC Tycoon 2 and Mobiles Tycoon (their short support time was caused by ineffective project structure and very long development time of mobile version), it'll also have better native support

The game is going to be released this spring

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534690/Games_Tycoon/

notes.title: Version 1.2.10
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing PC Tycoon 2! Version 1.2.10 changes:
- Stores tab in upgrades: you can invest money in your products distribution to sell more copies and get more fans
- Balance changes: marketing affects fans number and you gain fans faster
- Updated sandbox: you can now edit sales, fans and time flow speed multipliers
- Added “Help with translation” button, so that you can help improving game localization in your language
- Added czech and arabic languages support
- Some bug fixes and performance improvements
Have a nice game!

notes.title: Mobiles Tycoon is available
notes.notes:
My new game Mobiles Tycoon is available on Steam! It has all the benefits PC Tycoon 2 has, but let's you create your own smartphones and tablets, processors and operating systems for them. You can buy it with 15% off in a week

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022320/Mobiles_Tycoon/

notes.title: Version 1.2.8
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing PC Tycoon 2! Changes in version 1.2.8:
- Automatic closing of deals: when choosing the retail price of a product, you can also choose the price to sell to other companies or prohibit all transactions
- The slot machine, lottery and hacker attacks have been disabled at the request of the players
- Added windowed display mode
- Fixed a bug with downloading your own company logo from your device
- Improved translation into German, Indonesian, Hindi
- The thanks section has been updated
- Minor bugs fixed and overall performance improved
Have a nice game!

notes.title: Version 1.2.4

Have a nice game!
